entry.summary:
Ambitions of a Dried Pink Oyster Merchant! This chart shows price per pound for fresh and dried mushrooms, along with yield, flushes, total fresh weight, growth speed, and markets to give a clear view of revenue per yield.
Mushroom Fresh Yield / Flush (per chamber) Flushes / Month Total Fresh / Month (2 Chambers) Fresh Price / lb Dried Price / lb Growth Speed Key Markets
Pink/Blue/Golden Oyster 0.5–1 lb 2–4 2–8 lb $12–25 $80–160 Fast Farmers markets, restaurants, online, gourmet stores
King Oyster 0.5–1 lb 2–3 2–6 lb $7–15 $50–90 Medium Farmers markets, specialty restaurants, online shops
Shiitake 0.5–1 lb 2–3 2–6 lb $10–20 $50–90 Medium Farmers markets, restaurants, CSA boxes, online stores
Lion's Mane 0.3–0.5 lb 2–3 1.2–3 lb $8–36 $50–90 Medium-Slow Health-focused markets, restaurants, online medicinal shops
Maitake 0.3–0.5 lb 2–3 1.2–3 lb $8–15 $40–80 Medium Specialty grocery stores, restaurants, online stores, CSA boxes
Enoki 0.3–0.5 lb 2–3 1.2–3 lb $4–10 $40–80 Medium Asian grocery stores, farmers markets, restaurants, online
Button / Cremini / Portabella 1–2 lb 2–3 4–12 lb $2–6 $10–20 Fast Supermarkets, restaurants, farmers markets, CSA boxes
Fresh Yield / Flush: How much is harvested per flush in one chamber.
Flushes / Month: Number of harvests per month per chamber.
Total Fresh / Month (2 Chambers): Total fresh weight from both chambers.
Fresh Price / lb & Dried Price / lb: Retail price per pound, helps visualize revenue per yield.
Growth Speed: Fast, Medium, or Medium-Slow, based on mushroom type.
Key Markets: Best places to sell each mushroom type.
Tips
Selling dried mushrooms gives the highest revenue per pound.
Use one chamber for fast-growing mushrooms and one for premium mushrooms to maximize income.
Dehydrator or low-temp oven is recommended to dry mushrooms effectively.
Main sales channels: farmers markets, restaurants, specialty stores, online shops, CSA boxes, health-focused markets.

entry.title: My Google AI Agents Intensive Experience — Day-by-Day Reflections
entry.summary: The Google AI Agents Intensive Course was an exciting five-day journey into the world of intelligent, autonomous systems. Each day deepened my understanding of how AI agents reason, plan, and act in real-world scenarios. 🗓️ Day 1 – Introduction to Agentic AI The first day reshaped how I viewed AI. I learned that an agent is more than a model — it’s a system that can perceive, decide, and act toward achieving a goal. 🗓️ Day 2 – Building Simple AI Agents We moved from theory to hands-on practice by building our first simple agents. 🗓️ Day 3 – Tool Use and Planning This day was a game-changer. We explored tool-augmented agents — systems that can call APIs, retrieve live data, or even run code. 🗓️ Day 4 – Multi-Agent Collaboration We dove into the world of multi-agent systems, where different agents collaborate to solve complex problems. 🗓️ Day 5 – Capstone Project and Reflection For my capstone, I created a Research & Summarization Agent that retrieved information from Kaggle datasets and summarized it into structured insights. 💡 Final Reflection This intensive course completely changed how I view AI. I now see agents as goal-driven systems capable of acting, learning, and improving autonomously. I’m excited to keep experimenting with Gemini, Kaggle, and multi-agent frameworks — building toward a future where AI truly works with us, not just for us.
